wizard.chief_complaint_label: 1. What is your chief medical complaint or reason for visit?

wizard.body_area_label: 2. Which department or body area does this relate to?
wizard.symptom_duration_label: 3. How long have you experienced these symptoms?
wizard.current_meds_label: 4. What medications or supplements are you currently taking?
wizard.current_meds_hint: Include prescription drugs, over-the-counter pills, or vitamins.

wizard.edit_summary_label: Edit or add any last notes for the doctor:

wizard.abdm_consent_title: File Consultation Record to Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)
wizard.abdm_consent_desc: Authorize Health 4.0 to generate and push a standardized NRCeS FHIR R4 OPConsultRecord bundle to your linked ABDM Personal Health Record (PHR) app (Aarogya Setu / ABHA SBX).
wizard.abdm_data_disclosed: Data Disclosed: Clinical chief complaint, vitals & symptoms, AI pre-consultation briefing, and prescription summaries.
